prompts: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target image 1 is the 36-necklace atlas. Style references image 2 existing armor, image 3 existing clubs, image 4 existing sleepy cat protagonist. REDRAW all necklaces to truly belong to THIS simple hand-drawn doodle game, especially the cat's plain flat fill and slightly wonky chunky black marker contour. Retain all 36 necklace pendant identities and exact reading order, six columns six rows. Make shapes charming and SIMPLE, matte muted flat color areas, just one small broad flat shade like the old wooden clubs, black visibly hand-wobbled outlines. REMOVE glossy bead highlights, jewel sparkles, polished metallic gradients, 3D round shiny pearls, elaborate jewelry detail. Cords should mostly be a simple hand-drawn uneven loop; only a few simplified flat beads when needed, no dense beadwork. Pendants use just a few bold internal marks, not realistic texture. Gems are simple 2-3 flat color planes without glitter. Necklaces should look like a child's confident marker drawing, not fancy RPG jewelry. Keep recognizable stone, wooden disk, tooth, shell, leaves, copper ring; amber square, crescent, forest leaf, double tusks, water drop, snowflake; blue crystal, clover, feather, purple crystal, bat wing gem, red ruby; swirl shell, sun, lava rock, moon tear, lion, compass; green fang, winged heart, ringed planet, black fortress, phoenix, trident; gold winged blue gem, purple spike, triple crystal, white winged star, blue star, winged sun. Real transparent alpha background, no white background, no grid lines, no text, no cast shadows, no glow. All thirty-six isolated icons fully visible with generous transparent gutters, consistent size, precisely 6 columns by 6 rows. Match line weight at final small inventory thumbnail scale to reference armor/clubs; no cat faces on pendants.

Use case: style-transfer. Edit image1 the 36 necklace atlas. Image2 armor and image3 cat are style references. Keep precisely 36 necklaces in same 6 by 6 reading order and all pendant identities. User requires EACH necklace to read as ONE SOLID CONNECTED OBJECT, like the reference armor and cat. Thicken every cord to a bold continuous unbroken band. Every bead and pendant physically overlaps and joins that band with solid chunky connecting material; never detached or almost-touching tiny links. All wings, crystals, crescent and teardrop, spikes, leaves, stars and decorations are attached to their own pendant as one contiguous silhouette. Especially the three crystals must be fused together at their bases; the planet ring joins globe and cord; crescent and blue tear touch; no floating dots around blue star. Simplify visual clutter and simplify shiny shading into matte flat doodle colors. Chunky slightly wobbly black contour, very simple hand drawn cartoon, same family as image2 armor and image3 player. One small broad flat shade at most, no glints or sparkles, no gradients, no jewelry photo realism. Each necklace has a clear single readable compact silhouette; keep the central empty neck opening. Transparent alpha background, generous empty gutters, all icons fully inside their cells. No text, no shadows, no detached decorations. Maintain exact identities and order of original 36 pendants.

Precise object edit of this 36-icon necklace atlas. Preserve every necklace design and style exactly, but fix spacing. Make each necklace approximately 20 percent smaller within its own grid cell, keeping an evenly spaced exact 6 columns by 6 rows grid. Each icon must fit within a 155 by 155 pixel bounding box of a 209 by 209 cell on a 1254 square canvas. Need at least 35-45 pixels of completely empty transparent space separating EVERY neighboring icon horizontally AND vertically. Several vertically neighboring icons currently touch; MUST separate them. Crucial: EACH necklace is ONE connected solid silhouette, with thick continuous cord and attached pendant, but all 36 necklaces are separate objects with large gutters. Preserve actual transparency, no backgrounds, no grid lines, no text, no shadows. Flat hand drawn doodle style and chunky black outline unchanged. Keep all pendant identities and exact reading order. Make the three purple crystals fused at the bottom and all blue star dots solidly joined to the star.
